audit_declarations.declaration:
theorem OpenBaire.exists_open_refinement.{u_1} {X : Type u_1} [MetricSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X] {U : Set X}
  (hU : IsOpen U) (hne : Set.Nonempty U) {ε : Real} (hε : LT.lt 0 ε) :
  Exists fun V =>
    And (Eq (Set.iUnion fun n => V n) U)
      (∀ (n : Nat),
        And (IsOpen (V n))
          (And (Set.Nonempty (V n)) (And (LE.le (closure (V n)) U) (LE.le (Metric.ediam (V n)) (ENNReal.ofReal ε)))))
audit_declarations.name: OpenBaire.exists_open_refinement

theorem OpenBaire.exists_open_scheme.{u_1} (X : Type u_1) [MetricSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X] [Nonempty X] :

theorem OpenBaire.OpenScheme.image_cylinder.{u_1} {X : Type u_1} [MetricSpace X] (S : OpenBaire.OpenScheme X) [CompleteSpace X]
  (x : Nat → Nat) (n : Nat) :
  Eq (Set.image (OpenBaire.OpenScheme.limit S) (PiNat.cylinder x n)) (OpenBaire.OpenScheme.sets S (PiNat.res x n))

theorem OpenBaire.exists_continuous_open_surjective_of_completeSpace.{u_1} (X : Type u_1) [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X]

  Exists fun f => And (Continuous f) (And (IsOpenMap f) (Function.Surjective f))

theorem OpenBaire.exists_continuous_open_surjective.{u_1} (X : Type u_1) [TopologicalSpace X] [PolishSpace X] [Nonempty X] :

audit_declarations.declaration:
theorem OpenBaire.exists_continuous_open_surjective_iff_nonempty.{u_1} (X : Type u_1) [TopologicalSpace X] [PolishSpace X] :

# Open Baire-space representation

The construction follows the classical open-scheme proof in David Marker,
Descriptive Set Theory (Fall 2002), Theorem 1.17. All nonempty hypotheses
are explicit. Generic scheme limits and their continuity are credited to
Felix Weilacher's Mathlib CantorScheme development.
